checkedAlternates.risk: Bali and Phuket are both well-known tropical resort islands.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Bali is part of Indonesia; Phuket is part of Thailand.

checkedAlternates.risk: Okinawa has its own history as the Ryukyu Kingdom and a tropical climate.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Okinawa is a prefecture of Japan.

checkedAlternates.risk: Java is also a coffee and a programming-language name, which may confuse the label.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The island of Java is the main island of Indonesia.

authorReview.notes: Borneo is left out because it is shared by three countries.

blindPlaytest.notes: If testers hesitate over Okinawa, replace it with Shikoku.
